sloka: स पर्वततटाग्रस्थः पीडयन् पर्वतोत्तमम्।हनुमान् दृश्यते वीरो द्वितीय इव पर्वतः ।। ६.७४.३६ ।।
transliteration: sa parvatataṭāgrasthaḥ pīḍayan parvatottamam।hanumān dṛśyate vīro dvitīya iva parvataḥ ।। 6.74.36 ।।

translations.english: Standing on the summit of the foremost of the mountains, hero Hanuman pressing his feet seemed like a second mountain
